macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS - protein +7.9% and calories -8.4%, both inside tolerance, so portions stand. The turkey line is measure-anchored by the source's own 4 cooked cups, not each-assumed, and our 70-g-cooked-per-serving basis reproduces their protein within 8%. The fat shortfall (27.2 vs 33) is the identifiable divergence: their calculator most plausibly booked whole-milk mozzarella and a heavier mayo cup where ours books the low-moisture part-skim shredded row that matches the priced bags; direction is calorie-DOWN and the floor still clears by 32 cal. Carbs 12.1 vs their 8.6 is +3.5 g absolute on gross-vs-net counting, far under the 35 g gate either way.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 432.3 cal in [400, 650] PASS (floor margin 32 cal); carbs 12.1 g <= 35 PASS. Only optional line is unmeasured salt-and-pepper (zero-booked).

loud_flags: REPAIR 2026-08-16 (source-QA blocking finding, owner mapper): all four seasoning lines were scaled 3.5x instead of 1.75x and have been rescaled - main thyme 3.5 g -> 1.8 g, sauce thyme 1.8 g -> 0.9 g, main poultry seasoning 5.25 g -> 2.6 g, sauce poultry seasoning 2.6 g -> 1.3 g. The macro_cross_check recompute above predates the repair; the correction removes about 19 cal from the batch (~1.4 cal/serving, recompute ~430.9 vs 432.3), immaterial to the PASS verdict and the band check either way.

Floor margin is 32 cal and our recompute sits BELOW the source's own 472; if the spec lane re-bases any dairy line lighter (e.g. reduced-fat mozzarella) this recipe slides under 400. The full-fat rows booked here are load-bearing.
